# NICD NMC regression originals

These fixtures are unchanged official NICD source pages, extracted with PDFium
without rewriting their text or tables, plus the complete public October 2023
DOCX alternate. `provenance.json` records the original URL, SHA-256 of the complete
original, SHA-256 of the fixture, original page numbers and captured report
metadata. The complete originals and catalogue captures are retained separately
under `data/raw/za/nicd_nmc_full_history/`.

They exercise the 2023 current/comparison month layout, vital-status-only national
columns, suspected/probable footnotes, reversed case/death column order, true TB
blank cells, quarterly reports, an asymptomatic-carrier column, modern percentage
cells and inconsistent national/province or classification/status totals. Missing
cells are not zeroes. Deaths are patient vital status at notification. Source
period labels and count cohorts are retained separately.
